newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gas rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gas rating raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it raised its rating on Pacific Gas and Electric Co to market performer for the six months and 18 months. It previously carried an underperform rating on the company.

--EVEREN's earnings per share estimates remain at $1.90 for 1997 and $2 for 1998. Several gas acquisitions look promising on the surface, but are not yet incorporated in the EVEREN forecast, it said in a report.
--Pacific Gas, an electric and gas utility, was unchanged at 22-7/8.
